      "item_input": "adorablehamsterpets:music_disc_acorn"

      "type": "patchouli:crafting",
      "recipe": "adorablehamsterpets:music_disc_cheese_from_blue_cheese",
      "recipe2": "adorablehamsterpets:music_disc_cheese_from_parmesan",
      "title": "想恢復原樣……",
      "text": "   用乳製品淹沒它。"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "版權呢？",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<b>內容創作者看這裡 ↓</>$(br2)你知道嗎？四首歌曲都已<b>完整取得授權</>，可安心用於影片分享與直播平臺的營利內容。$(br2)歡迎在影片中使用！",
      "text_color": "000000"
    }
  ]
}

  "name": "樹木劫掠&盔甲",
  "icon": "adorablehamsterpets:acorn_shard",
  "category": "adorablehamsterpets:advanced_rodentry",
  "entry_color": "00AAAA",
  "sortnum": 1,
  "pages": [
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "樹木劫掠&盔甲",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "若要獲得倉鼠盔甲，首先要將你的倉鼠$(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>扔進</> 橡樹葉（或者在站在上面放下倉鼠）才能開始<dark_green><b>搜刮樹葉</>。$(br2)它們會鑽進樹葉裡，四處走動，然後最終叼著<dark_green><b>橡實</>出現在樹下，直到樹被薅禿。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "intro"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:spotlight",
      "title": "戰利品",
      "item": "adorablehamsterpets:acorn",
      "text": "<dark_green><b>橡實</>本身沒什麼用，除非你喜歡堆肥與噎到的風險。$(br2)用<b>切石機</>加工成$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>橡實殼碎片</>，可製作$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>盔甲</>，或時尚的$(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>橡實帽</>。",
      "anchor": "acorn"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:crafting",
      "recipe": "adorablehamsterpets:hamster_armor_acorn",
      "title": "硬菜沙拉",
      "text": "將橡實殼碎片與橡實帽組合，製作<dark_green><b>橡實製倉鼠鎧</>。$(br2)它會完全擋下攻擊傷害，直到耐久度耗盡。",
      "anchor": "acorn_armor"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:image",
      "title": "",
      "images": [
        "adorablehamsterpets:patchouli_books/hamster_tips_guide_book/images/acorn_armor/hamster_wearing_armor.png"

      "border": false,
      "text": "   就像狼鎧$(br)  ，但是更加$(br)  可愛。"

      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",

      "header_color": "00AAAA",

      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "enchanting"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "多讀書",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "附魔書與鐵砧可以為盔甲增加<b>經驗修補</>，<b>冰霜行者</>以及<b>靈魂疾行</>。$(br2)<light_gray><i>注意：保護與摔落緩衝對倉鼠無效，因此不能加在盔甲上。盔甲本身已經為倉鼠提供防禦，且倉鼠無視摔落傷害。別太貪。</>",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "enchanting_advanced"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:smithing",
      "recipe": "adorablehamsterpets:hamster_armor_netherite_smithing",
      "title": "軍備升級",
      "text": "在戰利品寶箱找到<dark_green><b>倉鼠鍛造模板</>了？太好了。$(br2)使用鍛造臺，以珍貴材料升級<dark_green><b>倉鼠鎧</>。$(br2)每種材料都有……<i>獨特</>的優勢。",
      "anchor": "upgrades"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "一階升級效果",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<light_gray><b>鐵：</>降低風阻，提高投擲速度。$(br)<gold><b>金：</>永久提升速度。$(br)<dark_purple><b>獄髓：</>讓倉鼠變得密實沉重，提供擊退抗性並大幅提高投擲傷害。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "perks"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "二階升級效果",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "<dark_aqua><b>鑽石：</>這是個相當昂貴的選擇。$(br2)將倉鼠用閃亮的石頭覆蓋；倉鼠覺得很棒。$(br2)倉鼠會開心到幫你拿東西而不是像之前那樣避開$(br)  它們。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "diamond_perk"
    },
    {
      "type": "patchouli:image",
      "title": "",
      "images": [
        "adorablehamsterpets:patchouli_books/hamster_tips_guide_book/images/acorn_armor/hamsters_wearing_diamond_armor.png"
      ],
      "border": false,
      "text": "   <light_gray><i>我和小倉鼠$(br)  在備戰</>"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "橡實經濟",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "樹木是有記性的。同一棵橡樹被搜刮太多次，就不再提供戰利品。$(br2)生態系大約要一天才會原諒你。$(br2)等不及？使用重設$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#reset_tree_heist)<b>指令</>，或設定中的$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>按鈕</>。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "economy"
    },
    {
      "type": "adorablehamsterpets:dynamic_page",
      "header": "市場操縱",
      "header_color": "00AAAA",
      "text": "覺得大自然太摳搜？我在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>設定介面</>裡給你新增了一個新的功能。$(br2)調高“橡實掉落機率”可以享受橡實雨（限制：每秒至多掉落一顆）。$(br2)當然揹包爆滿的時候可別來怪我。",
      "text_color": "000000",
      "anchor": "config"
    }
  ]
}
